ambiguities_or_notes: All three printed page markers, both deletion spans, four footnote references/definitions, abbreviations, and the abrupt unfinished-document framing are represented.

The 90-volume witness and audited Markdown print бугъ in the contrast with чинар. A later scholarly Tolstoy edition reads бук, which is semantically coherent with известное русским дерево; English therefore uses beech while preserving the Russian witness unchanged and documenting the anomaly.
мирный/немирный is kept unusually close as peaceful/non-peaceful because Tolstoy is explicitly playing on the unstable official distinction before glossing the area as dangerous.
воды is rendered waters in the period resort sense; курс is rendered season rather than introducing a medical regimen not stated in the passage.
прапорщица Хринева is rendered Ensign Khrinev's wife; аптекарша из Немок as the apothecary's wife, a German woman; no independent names are invented.
нижнее платье is rendered lower clothing rather than more specifically trousers because the source uses the broader period clothing term.
The source switches from regularized Russian into compressed pre-reform orthography on p. 216; English preserves content and structural markers without imitating orthographic corruption.
